description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based Bluetooth Mesh lighting application, initializing hardware, Bluetooth, and lighting states.

methods.name: light_default_var_init
methods.description: Initializes default lighting, temperature, and delta UV variables.

methods.name: light_default_status_init
methods.description: Retrieves and constrains lighting and temperature ranges, sets current states based on power-up state.

methods.name: update_vnd_led_gpio
methods.description: Updates vendor-specific LED GPIO based on user data.

methods.name: update_led_gpio
methods.description: Updates general LED GPIOs based on current light and temperature states.

methods.name: update_light_state
methods.description: Updates LED GPIOs and triggers work if transition is complete or reset flag is false.

methods.name: short_time_multireset_bt_mesh_unprovisioning
methods.description: Handles multi-press reset for Bluetooth Mesh unprovisioning.

methods.name: reset_counter_timer_handler
methods.description: Timer handler to reset the reset counter.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing hardware, Bluetooth, and lighting states, and starting timers.
